abstract: Maintains residential noise survey data and municipal environmental health permits
system_message:
You are the Environmental acoustic officer (EAO), responsible for maintaining residential noise survey data, municipal environmental health permits, and ecological avian monitoring records across proposed flight paths.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ecological avian monitoring（ECOL）
information_points.content:
EAO-ECOL-1AL：Ecological avian monitoring records indicate that the Great Glen Waterway Flight Route maintains a nesting raptor setback distance of 300 m horizontal clearance from active nesting locations within designated nature conservation buffers.
EAO-ECOL-I31：Ecological avian monitoring records indicate that the Highland Valley Low-Level Corridor maintains a nesting raptor setback distance of 500 m horizontal clearance from active nesting locations within designated nature conservation buffers.
EAO-ECOL-KSE：Ecological avian monitoring records indicate that the Grampian Ridge Navigation Alignment maintains a nesting raptor setback distance of 750 m horizontal clearance from active nesting locations within designated nature conservation buffers.

information_points.title: Maintains residential noise survey data and municipal environmental health permits（ENVNOI）
information_points.content:
EAO-ENVNOI-9Q2：For the Highland Valley Low-Level Corridor, municipal acoustic noise impact compliance is true, confirming that the predicted drone acoustic signature over residential settlements beneath the candidate flight path satisfies municipal noise guidelines.
EAO-ENVNOI-I53：For the Great Glen Waterway Flight Route, municipal acoustic noise impact compliance is false, as the predicted drone acoustic signature over residential settlements beneath the candidate flight path does not satisfy municipal noise guidelines.
EAO-ENVNOI-1SO：For the Grampian Ridge Navigation Alignment, municipal acoustic noise impact compliance is true, with the predicted drone acoustic signature over residential settlements beneath the candidate flight path satisfying municipal noise guidelines.
